title: Pure Cotton Comfort & Traditional Weave
comment: The fabric feels exceptionally breathable in Kolkata summer heat. Beautiful check borders and zero synthetic feel. Absolutely authentic handloom quality!

title: Exact traditional gamcha
comment: Water absorption is instant right after the first gentle wash. Reminds me of traditional weaves from Nadia district.

title: Stunning Zari Work for Wedding Wear
comment: Draped this Banarasi Tanchoi dupatta for my cousin's sangeet. The silk sheen and delicate floral zari jaal received countless compliments. Highly recommended!

title: Rich look and graceful drape
comment: Slightly heavier than organza, but that is expected for pure silk Tanchoi. Drapes elegantly on plain kurtas.

title: Featherlight Chanderi Elegance
comment: The translucent gold tissue border has a subtle, royal look. Matches perfectly with pastel anarkalis. Truly heirloom weave.

title: Intricate Geometric Phulkari
comment: The resham thread embroidery on fine chinon silk is dense and vibrant. Looks even richer in person than in product photos.
